# Source provenance

The original project implementation is MIT licensed. Source snapshots are not relicensed by that grant.

- `research/math/Answer.lean`, `AnswerSyntax.lean`, and `formal-conjectures-3.lean`, plus `research/autolab/Answer-at-image-date.lean`, come from [google-deepmind/formal-conjectures](https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures). Their source headers retain the original attribution and Apache 2.0 notice. A copy of that license is included in [licenses/Apache-2.0.txt](licenses/Apache-2.0.txt).
- `research/autolab/erdos-3/` preserves the public AutoLab hill for inspection and reproducibility. It is an upstream reference snapshot, not a proof submitted by this project. Original source hashes and the exact origin are recorded in [public-files-manifest.json](../research/autolab/public-files-manifest.json). The snapshot contains the upstream incomplete baseline intentionally.
- `research/math/status-3.yaml` is a short status excerpt from [teorth/erdosproblems](https://github.com/teorth/erdosproblems), used as a dated research reference.
- The event's slide decks are linked and summarized; the presentation files are not redistributed.

Sources, retrieval dates, and the difference between exact snapshots and historical-version inferences are documented in [the research report](../research/math-status.md) and [AutoLab report](../research/autolab.md).
